posts.content: 🎖 This week on TSN Talks… we sit down with one of the few Thai-Indian soldiers serving our beautiful country, Thailand. Major Sukit Khurana shares why he chose the military path, the discipline it demands, and what it truly means to represent both faith and nation in uniform. In this episode, we talk about his decision to serve, the highs and lows of military life, identity and representation, and the responsibilities (and the pride) that comes with serving as a Thai-Indian soldier. 📺 Full episode live TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube. Tune IN! #TSNTalks

🚨 This week on TSN Talks… Dr. Ravee Phol drops the kind of truth most parents aren’t ready to hear. From the real cost of international schools in Thailand… to why Thai students often outperform… to the question parents should ask before paying tuition: “What kind of person do you want your child to become?” Dr. Ravee challenges everything we assume about education — the costs, the outcomes, the Ivy League expectations (and the realities), and why Thai schools might be far better than most parents admit. One of our most eye-opening conversations yet. 📺 Full episode LIVE TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube. #TSNTalks

🚨 This week on TSN Talks… we sit down with Harprem Doowa — the entrepreneur behind PetLoft, Frank.co, and now Eazy Digital. In this episode, we talk about his journey from employee to founder, early failures, building Frank from the ground up, navigating a major exit, and starting again with Eazy Digital. Harprem breaks down the real reality of building products inside Thailand’s startup ecosystem. We talk about rejection, resilience, cross-culture lessons, and the real beginning of his entrepreneurial journey. From graduating and taking his first job, to pursuing an MBA at Sasin, to launching PetLoft as his first step into entrepreneurship — Harprem shares how each chapter shaped his mindset. We also dive into the his journey and rise with Frank.co, one of Southeast Asia’s first digital insurance platforms, how it scaled, and what came after the big exit. 📺 Full episode Live NOW on TSN Talks YouTube. #TSNTalks

🎇 This week on TSN Talks, we’re celebrating the festival of lights — and the people who make it shine. Every year, Thailand’s Diwali Festival brings thousands together, but few know the team behind it. Ahead of this year’s Diwali Festival Celebration at ICONSIAM (17–19 October), we’re joined by Mr. Chuan Thakur, President of the Indian Association of Thailand (IAT), and Mr. Preecha Champi, The Festival Director — leading Thailand’s Diwali organizing team for the past five years. 📺 Live Tonight on TSN Talks Youtube!  #tsntalks

This week on TSN Talks, we sit down with the President of BNI – The One Chapter, Mr. Nathapol Sirinarang. After spending over 20 years working in the same industry, Nathapol reached a point where he wanted a fresh perspective, not just on business, but on people, collaboration, and growth. That journey led him to BNI, a global networking organization built on one simple philosophy: Givers Gain. In this episode, we unpack what BNI really is and why structured networking can act as a “training center” for business owners. Nathapol shares how surrounding yourself with the right community can sharpen your thinking, challenge blind spots, and open doors you can’t unlock alone. This is a conversation about collaboration over competition, learning through giving, and how strong businesses are built through relationships. 📺 Full episode live TONIGHT on TSN Talks YouTube. #TSNTalks #BNI #tsntalks #BusinessCommunity #giversgain

🔥 What does it take to turn food waste into one of Asia’s hottest startups?  In this week’s episode of TSN Talks, we sit down with Mahima Rajangam Natarajan, Co-Founder & CMO of @Yindii_th — one of Asia’s hottest startups fighting food waste.  From starting with a WordPress site and one merchant in Sukhumvit… to 700K+ app downloads across 3 countries, Yindii has saved over half a million meals and built a movement of “food heroes.”  🔥 Purpose, grit, and storytelling — this is how real change is made.  📺 FULL episode premieres tomorrow, 27th September 8pm on TSN Talks YouTube. #tsntalks #yindii

Your phone is dying. What do you do? 🔋 This simple problem has become a massive business. On the next episode of TSN Talks, we sit down with Anand Koghar from @chargespot.th to learn how the company is helping people stay connected when they need it most. ⚡️ With 20M downloads and 11M users globally, Chargespot has created a network of portable power banks that you can pick up at one location and return at another. 📱 Scan. ⚡️ Rent. 🔋 Charge. 📍 Return anywhere. And in Thailand alone, Chargespot already has around 1 million users, with Anand leading the growth and getting them into venues including Siam Paragon, 7-11, Jiffy and more.  #TSNTalks #ThaiSikhNews #Chargespot #thailand

🥗 This week on TSN Talks…we sit down with Anchit Sachdev, Co-Founder & MD of @getfreshth — the brand that is redefining healthy eating in Thailand. Anchit takes us through his 14-year journey of making nutritious food truly accessible in Thailand — from the early challenges of working under a franchisor, to scaling across Bangkok, surviving Covid, and growing to 20+ outlets and canteen management partnerships with leading international schools.  From finding local Thai farms to source organic ingredients from, to navigating operations in a rapidly changing F&B landscape, to building a team culture grounded in consistency and purpose - we unpack a few interesting topics in this conversation.  More than just salads - this episode dives into what real impact looks like. Balancing growth with authenticity, and leading with purpose.  📺 Full episode out tomorrow night, 8pm on TSN Talks YouTube. Stay tuned!  #TSNTalks #Getfresh #sustainability #healthy
